title: The Real Cost of a Formula 1 Car for the Road
description:
The Mercedes-AMG One costs about two point seven million dollars. And a rumour says that after about fifty thousand kilometres, its engine needs a full factory rebuild that costs around eight hundred fifty thousand euros. Top Gear says that rumour is not quite accurate. So what does a Formula One car for the road really cost to own? This is what the sources say, and what they do not. Here is the twist. The price on the window is not even the biggest number in this story. A build slot for this car was once listed for nearly double the original price, before a single car was built. And one of the most important costs of all, the engine rebuild, has no published price anywhere that we could verify.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
